title: NX-14 (Nexafib) as a potent ROCK2 inhibitor: Preclinical efficacy in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis models
body: This study demonstrates the preclinical efficacy of NX-14 (Nexafib), a selective ROCK2 inhibitor, in reducing pulmonary fibrosis in mouse models of bleomycin-induced injury. NX-14 treatment significantly reduced collagen deposition (p<0.001), myofibroblast differentiation (p<0.01), and pro-fibrotic cytokine expression (IL-6, TNF-α, TGF-β1). Pharmacokinetic studies showed favorable oral bioavailability and lung tissue penetration. No significant off-target ROCK1 inhibition was observed at therapeutic doses.
